items.title: Cybersecurity Newsletter Weekly – Shai Halud Attack, Ivanti Exploits, FinWise, BMW Data Leak, and More
items.description: This week in cybersecurity, researchers exposed hidden alliances between ransomware groups, the rise of AI-powered phishing platforms, and large-scale vulnerabilities affecting telecom and enterprise systems. Major data breaches at financial services and luxury brands highlighted insider threats and supply chain risks, while arrests of Scattered Spider hackers signaled rare law enforcement wins.…

items.title: DPRK Hackers Use ClickFix to Deliver BeaverTail Malware in Crypto Job Scams
items.description: Threat actors with ties to the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (aka DPRK or North Korea) have been observed leveraging ClickFix-style lures to deliver a known malware called BeaverTail and InvisibleFerret. "The threat actor used ClickFix lures to target marketing and trader roles in cryptocurrency and retail sector organizations rather than targeting software development roles," GitLab

items.title: New EDR-Freeze Tool That Puts EDRs and Antivirus Into A Coma State
items.description: A new proof-of-concept tool named EDR-Freeze has been developed, capable of placing Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and antivirus solutions into a suspended “coma” state. According to Zero Salarium, the technique leverages a built-in Windows function, offering a stealthier alternative to the increasingly popular Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver (BYOVD) attacks used by threat actors […] The…
